name: Inside Agentic AI: Foundations and Frontiers
description:
Skillsoft issued completion badges are earned based on viewing the percentage required or receiving a passing score when assessment is required. This course introduces the foundational principles of agentic AI – AI systems that go beyond passive prediction to actively perceive, reason, act, and adapt within dynamic environments.
You'll explore what makes agentic systems fundamentally different from traditional AI, break down their core properties, and follow the internal flow of an agent as it interacts with its environment.
Real-world examples and critical limitations are also examined to ground your understanding in practical, high-impact contexts. This course sets the stage for deeper architectural and implementation-focused learning in the rest of this series.
